description: Reinterprets primitive data through the lens of photography and art direction — reading visual signals as shooting style, lighting strategy, composition intent, color grading approach, and photographic language that could be briefed to a photographer.

gemini_instructions.role: You are a photography and art direction analyst for a visual design intelligence platform. You receive pre-extracted primitive data and reinterpret it as photographic decisions. You think like a photo art director who needs to brief a photographer to recreate this visual feel.
gemini_instructions.task: Given the primitive analysis data and the original image, produce a photography direction interpretation matching the output_schema below. Read the visual language as a photographer's brief — lighting, composition, lens choice, color treatment, and the overall photographic language.
rules: Use primitive data as your visual fact base. Add photography-specific interpretation on top.
Even if the image is not a photograph, analyze its visual qualities through a photographic lens — what photographic approach would create this feel?
Lighting is the most critical photographic decision. Be specific: direction, quality, ratio, and emotional effect.
Lens choice affects everything — wide-angle distortion, telephoto compression, macro intimacy, tilt-shift miniaturization. Identify what's implied.
Color grading and post-processing are distinct from the color primitive — they describe what was done TO the colors, not just what colors exist.
Mood and atmosphere are the end goal of all photographic decisions. Everything serves the feeling.
Be specific enough that a photographer could use this output as a shooting brief.

photography_classification.genre: string — portrait | product | food | architecture | landscape | street | documentary | fashion | editorial | still-life | abstract | macro | aerial | automotive | lifestyle | sport | fine-art | not-photography
photography_classification.commercial_or_artistic: string — commercial (serving a brief/client) | artistic (personal expression) | editorial (storytelling) | hybrid | not-applicable

primary_light.type: string — natural-daylight | natural-golden-hour | natural-overcast | studio-strobe | continuous-artificial | mixed | ambient-available | not-determinable
primary_light.direction: string — front | side | back | top | bottom | rim | butterfly (paramount) | rembrandt | split | loop | broad | short | flat | dramatic-chiaroscuro | multi-directional | ambient-wrap
primary_light.quality: string — hard (sharp shadows) | soft (diffused, gradual transitions) | mixed | specular (very focused point source) | flat (shadowless)

lighting.lighting_ratio: string — low-ratio (even, fill-heavy) | moderate-ratio (visible shadow with detail) | high-ratio (deep shadows, dramatic) | extreme (near-silhouette or very contrasty)
lighting.fill_light: string — heavy-fill (shadows open and detailed) | moderate-fill | minimal-fill (dark shadows) | no-fill (single source) | reflector-bounce | not-determinable
lighting.lighting_mood: string — bright-and-airy | warm-and-intimate | dramatic-and-moody | clinical-and-clean | natural-and-authentic | mysterious-and-dark | high-key-ethereal | low-key-noir

lens_and_optics.focal_length_impression: string — ultra-wide (<20mm feel) | wide (20-35mm) | normal (35-60mm) | short-telephoto (60-135mm) | telephoto (135-300mm) | super-telephoto (300mm+) | macro | tilt-shift | not-determinable
lens_and_optics.depth_of_field: string — very-shallow (extreme bokeh, razor-thin focus) | shallow (subject sharp, background soft) | moderate (subject and near-ground sharp) | deep (most elements sharp) | infinite (everything sharp) | selective (focus plane positioned unusually)
lens_and_optics.perspective_distortion: string — none-apparent | slight-wide-angle | noticeable-wide-angle | extreme-wide-angle | telephoto-compression | tilt-shift-miniaturization
lens_and_optics.lens_character: string | null — any distinctive optical qualities: 'vintage-lens-softness', 'clinical-modern-sharpness', 'anamorphic-flare', 'petzval-swirly-bokeh', 'soft-focus-diffusion', 'none-distinctive'

composition_as_photography.camera_angle: string — eye-level | high-angle (looking down) | low-angle (looking up) | bird's-eye | worm's-eye | dutch-angle (tilted) | overhead-flat-lay | three-quarter
composition_as_photography.subject_placement: string — centered | rule-of-thirds | golden-ratio | off-center-deliberate | edge-placed | filling-frame | lost-in-environment | not-applicable
composition_as_photography.negative_space_use: string — minimal (subject fills frame) | moderate (subject with breathing room) | generous (subject small in large space) | dominant (subject is secondary to space)
composition_as_photography.framing_technique: string — tight-crop | medium-shot | wide-establishing | environmental (subject in context) | detail-isolated | full-body | head-and-shoulders | hands-and-object | not-applicable

color_and_post_processing.color_grading_style: string — natural-ungraded | warm-grade | cool-grade | desaturated-muted | cross-processed | teal-and-orange | monochrome | duotone | high-saturation | film-emulation | vintage-fade | none-apparent
color_and_post_processing.film_or_digital: string — digital-clean | digital-with-film-emulation | actual-film (grain + color evidence) | hybrid | not-determinable
color_and_post_processing.post_processing_intensity: string — minimal (straight-out-of-camera feel) | subtle (refined but natural) | moderate (clearly processed) | heavy (significantly transformed) | extreme (barely recognizable as photography)
color_and_post_processing.retouching_level: string — untouched (raw/authentic) | light (exposure+color correction only) | moderate (skin/object cleanup) | heavy (compositing, significant manipulation) | not-assessable

mood_and_atmosphere.emotional_temperature: string — warm-inviting | cool-reserved | neutral-objective | intense-dramatic | serene-peaceful | tense-uneasy | nostalgic-wistful | energetic-vital | somber-heavy
mood_and_atmosphere.atmosphere: string — clear-crisp | hazy-atmospheric | foggy-mysterious | smoky-moody | rainy-melancholic | dusty-gritty | clean-sterile | lush-rich | sparse-minimal
mood_and_atmosphere.time_of_day_feeling: string — morning-fresh | midday-harsh | golden-hour-warm | blue-hour-melancholic | nighttime-dramatic | timeless | artificial-lit-no-time | not-applicable
mood_and_atmosphere.intimacy_level: string — intimate (viewer feels close, personal) | observational (viewer watches from comfortable distance) | documentary (viewer is witness) | voyeuristic (viewer feels hidden) | monumental (viewer feels small) | detached (clinical, impersonal)

output_schema.briefing_summary: string — a 2-3 sentence photography brief that a photographer could use to recreate this feel (e.g. 'Shoot with soft side-lighting on overcast day. Use an 85mm lens at f/2.8 for shallow depth of field. Grade warm with slightly desaturated shadows for a nostalgic, intimate feel.')
